title: Acoustic - Private rooftop deck & fire pit
description:
Perched in The Gulch, this designer 4-bedroom condo offers an exclusive private rooftop deck with skyline views—perfect for sunset gatherings.
Full chef’s kitchen & dishwasher
Indoor fireplace, fast Wi-Fi, washer/dryer
Steps to cafés, music venues & boutiques
Relax on cushy seating under the stars, then sink into premium linens inside. Superhost hospitality comes standard—book your Nashville stay today!

The space
Highlights:
•	We own 8 units next to each other, larger groups please reach out. 
•	Private roof top deck with views, projector, grill and seating
•	Free parking in the 2 car garage
•	Walk Score 85 (walk to Gulch, cafes, dining, shopping, nightlife)
•	Fully equipped + stocked kitchen
•	5 minute drive to downtown Nashville

Perfect for larger groups or multiple families looking to travel together. Acoustic is equipped with custom kitchens and professional appliances, designer spa like baths with Italian tile and faucets, incredible lighting, soaring ceilings, unique and beautiful wall treatments, and rooftop decks with 360 degrees views of downtown. Book now and make this the choice for your next group trip or work getaway to Music city. 

Bed Setup for this home:
★ Master Bedroom (3rd Level): King bed with suite bathroom
★ 2nd Bedroom (3rd Level): 2 twin bunkbeds- full bathroom right outside the room   
★ 3rd Bedroom (3rd Level): King bed with full bath right outside the bedroom (shared with 2nd BR)
★ 4th Bedroom (1st Level): Queen with full bath right outside the bedroom
★ 2 cots stored on site

Unwind Luxury Vacations is the professional management company for this home, and committed to curating your 5-star experience.

Guest access
Full access to the unit plus rooftop lounge.
